tool_description: AutoMorph_quality is a Docker-based tool for automated quality control of retinal fundus images. It evaluates image quality based on softmax outputs and standard deviation, and filters images using user-defined thresholds.

input.description: Path to the input folder containing retinal fundus images (e.g., PNG or JPG format).

output.description: Path to the output folder where the quality assessment results will be saved.

bad_mean_threshold.description: Threshold for mean softmax probability of 'bad' quality. Images with a 'bad' score above this value may be excluded.

usable_sd_threshold.description: Threshold for standard deviation of 'usable' quality. Images with high uncertainty may be excluded.

quality_results_csv.description: Path to the output CSV file containing quality scores and predicted labels for each image.

filtered_images_folder.description: Path to the folder containing only images that passed the quality filter.

description.Name: Image file name
description.raw_Prediction: Raw class output (0: good, 1: usable, 2: bad)
